# CmisVcsFirTapStepSize — CMIS-VCS 1.1 FIR Tap Step Size Attribute

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisVcsFirTapStepSize`
- Description: Values of the StepSize descriptor attribute of the FIR tap weight VCS Parameters (read-write ID 0Dh, read-only ID 12h), OIF-CMIS-VCS-01.1 §§ 5.15 and 5.20 (Tables 5-33 and 5-45), encoded in 8 bits. The actual tap weight is the S8 register value multiplied by the step size; the supported range is -128 * StepSize to +127 * StepSize (Tables 5-32 and 5-44). § 5.15 scales dimensionless tap weights; § 5.20 states the step in dB. Both printings share the encoding recorded here.
